title: A compliance record's fields, Certificate number and attachment
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. Open the record form: on the asset card Compliance section click "+ Add record" on a compliance service.
custom_steps:
1. Read the fields on the form and their widths.
  2. Read the number field label and whether it is required.
  3. Add an attachment, then replace it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A record carries type, term, effective date, expiry date, an optional artefact number and one optional attachment; field widths follow one scale, half or full.
  • The number field is labelled "Certificate number"; it is optional but always present.
  • The attachment reuses the DVI attachment component; replacing the file replaces the record's only attachment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S8; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R2: “A record will carry type, term, effective date, expiry date, an optional artefact number and one optional attachment”
  • S8-R3: “The number field is labelled Certificate number”
  • S8-R4: “The number field is optional but always present. Every v1 type produces a document”
  • S8-R6: “Field widths will follow one scale, half or full”
  • S8-R9: “The attachment will reuse the DVI attachment component. Replacing the file replaces the record's only attachment”
